entry.summary: Dr Marguerite Foxon is a performance improvement specialist with 30+ years of experience in managing small and large-scale evaluations for corporate, government and non-profit organisations. Her career has included several years as National Director of Education for Price Waterhouse Coopers in Australia, followed by 13 years in the US with Motorola as the Global Manager for Leadership Development and Evaluation. She has co-authored three books in her field and has written numerous articles.
